files.SKILL.md:
---
name: Daily train check
description: >-
  7:00am local, all seven days. Ask if training happened.
schedule: 0 7 * * *
timezone: {timezone}
paused: true
---
Ask if training happened today. If yes, log it in one line and stay short. If no, rewrite the next session so the week still holds. If a wearable is connected and recovery is red, one line and lower intensity. Do not cancel the week. Do not diagnose. Never prescribe. Never invent numbers that were not pulled from a connected workout app, nutrition app, wearable, or lab. Stay quiet only if the user already logged today's session.

Fires on:
- cron `0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

name: Sunday health review
description: >-
  Sunday 5:00pm local. Five-line week review.
schedule: 0 17 * * 0
timezone: {timezone}
paused: true
---
Five lines only. Sessions hit, sessions missed, sleep if a wearable is connected, one new lab or wearable trend if data landed, one change for next week. No dashboard essay. Never invent numbers that were not pulled from a connected source. Do not diagnose. Never prescribe.

Fires on:
- cron `0 17 * * 0`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
